arxiv-2205-15527.title: Complete analysis of the maximally hyperentangled state via the weak cross-Kerr nonlinearity
arxiv-2205-15527.creator: Zhi Zeng
arxiv-2205-15527.description: Abstract We present a simple method for the complete analysis of maximally hyperentangled state in polarization and spatial-mode degrees of freedom assisted by the weak cross-Kerr nonlinearity. Our method not only can be used for two-photon hyperentangled Bell state analysis and three-photon hyperentangled Greenberger-Horne-Zeilinger (GHZ) state analysis, but also is suitable for N N -photon hyperentangled GHZ state analysis.

arxiv-2208-01523.title: Transient Structure in the Non-linear Superradiance Regime of Widely Doppler Broadened Media 2022 Transient Structure in the Non-linear Superradiance Regime of Widely Doppler Broadened Media – 24
arxiv-2208-01523.creator: C. Wyenberg, F. Rajabi, M. Chamma, A. Kumar, M. Houde
arxiv-2208-01523.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by C. Wyenberg, F. Rajabi, M. Chamma, A. Kumar, M. Houde. We investigate transient radiation processes in the non-linear superradiance (SR) regime of the Doppler broadened Maxwell-Bloch equations when the velocity distribution is of total bandwidth greatly exceeding that of the transient process itself. We demonstrate the formation of global polarisation phase correlation and the quenching of temporal structure if a smooth distribution is inverted above the critical threshold required to enter the non-linear SR regime.

arxiv-2306-07041.title: Quantum simulation of generic spin exchange models in Floquet-engineered Rydberg atom arrays
arxiv-2306-07041.creator: Naveen Nishad, Anna Keselman, Thierry Lahaye, Antoine Browaeys, Shai Tsesses
arxiv-2306-07041.description: Abstract Although quantum simulation can give insight into elusive or intractable physical phenomena, many quantum simulators are unavoidably limited in the models they mimic. Such is also the case for atom arrays interacting via Rydberg states – a platform potentially capable of simulating any kind of spin exchange model, albeit with currently unattainable experimental capabilities.

arxiv-2310-08364.title: Map2Schedule: An End-to-End Link Scheduling Method for Urban V2V Communications
arxiv-2310-08364.creator: Lihao Zhang, Haijian Sun, Jin Sun, Ramviyas Parasuraman, Yinghui Ye, Rose Qingyang Hu
arxiv-2310-08364.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Lihao Zhang, Haijian Sun, Jin Sun, Ramviyas Parasuraman, Yinghui Ye, Rose Qingyang Hu. Urban vehicle-to-vehicle (V2V) link scheduling with shared spectrum is a challenging problem. Its main goal is to find the scheduling policy that can maximize system performance (usually the sum capacity of each link or their energy efficiency). Given that each link can experience interference from all other active links, the scheduling becomes a combinatorial integer programming problem and generally does not scale well with the number of V2V pairs.

arxiv-2312-09996.title: Integration of Second-Order Bandstop Filter Into a Dual-Polarized 5G Millimeter-Wave Magneto-Electric Dipole Antenna
arxiv-2312-09996.creator: Jiangcheng Chen, Markus Berg, Kimmo Rasilainen, Zeeshan Siddiqui, Marko E. Leinonen, Aarno Pärssinen
arxiv-2312-09996.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Jiangcheng Chen, Markus Berg, Kimmo Rasilainen, Zeeshan Siddiqui, Marko E. Leinonen, Aarno Pärssinen. This communication proposes a dual-wideband differentially fed dual-polarized magnetoelectric (ME) dipole with second-order bandstop filtering for millimeter-wave (mm-Wave) applications at 24.25–29.5 GHz and 37–43.5 GHz. Without disturbing the complementary antenna operation, two resonator types (hairpin and coupled λ {\lambda} /4 open-/short-circuited stub resonators), are embedded into the wideband ME dipole to create two transmission poles and two zeros for sharp band-edge selectivity.

arxiv-2508-20293.description: Abstract . Quantization is a widely used compression technique for reducing the memory and computation costs of large pre-trained models. A key challenge in per-channel post-training quantization (PTQ) is selecting appropriate scaling factors to replace weight values with values from a scaled integer grid. Existing methods typically fix the scale at the outset via heuristic tuning or grid search.

britannica-1911-hitchcock-george.title: Hitchcock, George (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-hitchcock-george.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-hitchcock-george.description: Article 'Hitchcock, George' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 13), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. born at Providence, Rhode Island, in 1850. He graduated from Brown University in 1872 and from the law school of Harvard University in 1874; then turned his attention to art and became a pupil of Boulanger and Lefebvre in Paris. He attracted notice in the Salon of 1885 with his “Tulip Growing,” a Dutch garden which he painted in Holland.

pmc-12642340.title: What older adults say about participating in health-promoting activities to prevent frailty: a qualitative study
pmc-12642340.creator: Seaw Jia Liew, Melvyn Chung Pheng Wong, Huso Yi, Doris Yee Ling Young, Richard Jor Yeong Hui
pmc-12642340.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundHealth-promoting programs have been implemented to prevent frailty amongst older adults in Singapore which has a rapidly aging society. However, participation rate in such programs seemed lower than expected, despite the programs being physically and financially accessible. There is little local research about older adults’ personal health beliefs and attitudes towards participating in health-promoting activities to prevent frailty, as well as external influences on their perceptions.

pmc-13413424.title: Inflammatory Mediators Involved in Conjunctival and Corneal Remodeling of Vernal Keratoconjunctivitis
pmc-13413424.creator: Nicholas J. Karbach, Fiza Tariq
pmc-13413424.description: Vernal keratoconjunctivitis (VKC) is a chronic condition that causes remodeling of the cornea and conjunctiva through recurring episodes of allergic inflammation of the ocular surface. This can lead to corneal scarring, keratoconus, and chronic conjunctival papillae. However, the details of the immunopathological processes behind these remodeling changes are not completely understood.

uslaw-usc-t49-s47145.title: 49 U.S.C. § 47145 — Pilot program for airport accessibility
uslaw-usc-t49-s47145.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t49-s47145.description: United States Code, Title 49 (Transportation); Part B (Airport Development And Noise); Chapter 471 (Airport Development); Subchapter I (Airport Improvement). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) In General.— The Secretary of Transportation shall establish and carry out a pilot program to award grants to sponsors to carry out capital projects to upgrade the accessibility of commercial service airports for individuals with disabilities.
